description: Land Title Settlement Department - Palliyagodella, Medirigiriya D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120063
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land ownership for numerous parcels of land in various locations. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, extents, owners, and title classifications under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
